title: Server Rules
summary: This page outlines the official guidelines for uploading levels, submitting Demon List records, and participating in the Maxr3 GDPS community.

sections.heading: Level Uploading & Rating
sections.content:
• Levels must be legitimately verified without noclip, speedhacks, or macro bots.
  • Copied or stolen levels from official servers without significant transformation will not be rated.

sections.heading: Demon List Submissions
sections.content:
• All Demon List completions require raw footage with audible clicks or a visible cheat indicator.
  • CBF (Click Between Frames) and physics bypass rules follow the current Demon List leaderboard standards.
